mainEntity.name: How long does a bow window installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bow window installation typically ranges from one to three days, depending on the complexity of the project. Factors that can influence the timeline include the size of the window, whether a new opening needs to be created or an existing one enlarged, and the condition of the surrounding wall structure. Custom framing or structural modifications, if required, will add to the overall time. We ensure careful attention to detail for proper sealing and insulation, which is crucial for the longevity and performance of the window.
